title: updates / Disable automatic updates
content:
## Disable automatic updates

To prevent {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} from automatically checking for or installing updates, set the `UpdateMode` policy to `none`:

**Policy value**:

```text
none
```

When updates are disabled, users cannot update {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} through the application. You can then control {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} versions through your software deployment tools.
